## Fundamentals #0030: Automatic Data Processing: 1Q2027 results

Date: 2026-10-28 21:39
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-28-0030/


Automatic Data Processing (ADP) revenues increased in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 by 6.1% y/y to 5.49 billion USD, and earnings per share (reported) increased by 13.7% y/y to 2.83 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (reported, basic) was 2.84 USD (13.6% y/y).

### Company guidance

For the full fiscal year 2027, the company expects revenue growth of 6.0%, (adjusted) earnings per share growth in the range of 10.0% – 12.0%, and earnings per share growth of 12.0% – 14.0%. The company also forecasts interest income at 1.59 billion USD – 1.61 billion USD and a tax rate of 23.0%.

### What management says

Management emphasized that progress in the field of artificial intelligence, especially regarding the ADP Assist assistant, is significant. According to management, the selection of subsequent AI agents is based on solutions that provide measurable results to clients and solve real problems. Management indicated that the new agreement regarding the inclusion of payroll into the banking platform is a key element of strategic priority, and similar discussions are ongoing. According to management, client employment results in the quarter were satisfactory and represent a continuation of growing momentum. Management believes it is in the interest of shareholders to allocate part of the improvement in results to dividends and part to further development.

## Fundamentals #0029: Old Dominion Freight Line: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-28 19:49
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-28-0029/


Old Dominion Freight Line (ODFL) revenue in Q3 was 1.59 billion USD (+13.1% y/y), and earnings per share (reported) increased by 28.9% y/y to 1.65 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (reported, basic) reached 1.66 USD (+28.7% y/y) compared to 1.29 USD in the previous year.

### Company guidance

Capital expenditures in FY 2026 are expected to be 380.00 million USD.

### Management commentary

According to management, demand remains stable, and discussions with customers indicate an improving demand environment. Management emphasized that higher shipment weight allows maintaining stable revenue per unit of weight without fuel, confirming the effectiveness of the pricing policy. Management also indicated that most of the increase in cost per employee results from rising supplemental benefit costs related to inflation in healthcare. According to management, the company has a large reserve of capacity in real estate and equipment, and due to in-house driver training, it does not experience issues with employee recruitment. Management noted that by maintaining the current revenue level and seasonally better-than-usual results, the operating ratio should be at the lower limit of the normal range of deterioration.


---

## Fundamentals #0028: PayPal: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-28 19:42
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-28-0028/


PayPal (PYPL) revenue in Q3 was 8.58 billion USD (+2.0% y/y), while earnings per share (accounting) fell to 1.25 USD (−3.9% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (accounting, basic) was 1.26 USD (−3.8% y/y). The company's operating income was at the level of 1.40 billion USD (−7.8% y/y).

### What management says

Management emphasized that the goal is to increase Venmo's significance in customers' daily finances by developing the current base and expanding the offering with financial services. According to management, financial services constitute a key driver of future transaction margin growth, in which the company intends to continue investing. Management also indicated that AI agent-led commerce is a priority and a great opportunity for the company, based on trust and security. Management also noted that in the area of credit financing, it will maintain a balanced approach between on-balance sheet and off-balance sheet. According to management, the impact of EU de minimis customs duties on trade in Europe will also persist in the next quarter. Management also emphasized that it is open to an objective analysis of options to increase shareholder value, and is currently focusing on the implementation of its own plan.


---

## Fundamentals #0027: Baker Hughes: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-28 19:39
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-28-0027/


Baker Hughes (BKR) revenue increased by 14.5% y/y in the third quarter to 8.03 billion USD, while net income fell by 32.5% y/y to 411.00 million USD.

### Quarterly results

Adjusted earnings per share were 0.70 USD (2.9% y/y), while reported earnings per share fell to 0.41 USD (−32.8% y/y).

### What management says

Management emphasized that order growth is driven by enduring trends, such as increasing demand for power generation capacity in the United States related to data centers and investments in gas infrastructure. According to management, order strength is broad, manifesting in growth in power systems and LNG, as well as a growing equipment base supporting service. Management expects revenue growth and EBITDA margin expansion in the following year, noting that margin improvement will not be linear but will result from cost synergies and a more favorable sales mix. According to management, a seasonal decline will occur in the first quarter in subsequent quarters, with a clearer improvement in the second half of the year. At the same time, management is taking a cautious approach to short-term prospects in the Middle East, expecting a weakening of activity in this region.


---

## Fundamentals #0026: NXP Semiconductors: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-28 19:36
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-28-0026/


NXP Semiconductors (NXPI) revenues in Q3 were 3.79 billion USD (+19.3% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP) increased to 3.48 USD (+40.3% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP, basic) reached 3.51 USD (+40.4% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) was 4.20 USD (+35.0% y/y).

### What management says

Management emphasized that no widespread inventory replenishment is being observed in the automotive sector, with longer lead times improving demand visibility. According to management, confidence in continued growth is based on the increasing adoption of software-defined vehicles and the impact of artificial intelligence on industry and the Internet of Things. Management indicated that the gross margin improvement is structural and results from higher revenues, better fab utilization, and operational efficiency, while price increases merely cover higher costs. According to management, there is a structural shift in pricing within the industry, allowing semiconductors to capture a larger share of value in systems. Management noted that in data centers, growth depends on product launches, their adoption, and software deployment by customers. According to management, the company already has won projects in North America and the Asia-Pacific region, and is also conducting several pilots in China and Europe.


---

## Fundamentals #0025: Seagate Technology Holdings PLC: 1Q2027 results

Date: 2026-10-28 19:33
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-28-0025/


Seagate Technology Holdings PLC (STX) revenues in the first quarter were 4.23 billion USD (+61.0% y/y), and earnings per share (reported) increased to 7.59 USD (+212.3% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (reported, basic) reached 7.72 USD (+199.2% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) was 7.68 USD. The company's operating income was 2.06 billion USD (+197.4% y/y).

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that instead of destroying demand, they are observing its increasing creation on a quarter-to-quarter basis. According to management, the slower growth in shipments in the past period was planned well in advance and was not a result of issues during product transitions. Management noted that the pricing strategy remains unchanged, and new contracts incorporate higher costs of external components, which are more than covered by rising prices. According to management, the share buyback will clearly increase from the next quarter, as the company no longer plans further debt repayment activities. Management also indicated that corporate customers and hardware manufacturers are increasingly less likely to fall behind in purchasing the highest-capacity drives.

## Log #0212: Session summary 2026-10-26: NDX 29272.46 (+1.09%)

Date: 2026-10-26 21:03
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/posts/log-0212/


> ⚠️ **ERRATUM (2026-10-27)**
> **The first version of this entry gave the closing state of the market from an outdated reading.** In the last minutes of the session, old readings from earlier in the day and from Friday reached Heniu alongside the current ones: with the current percentage change, but with an old price, flow, daily range and market breadth. The close was recorded from such a reading. We have corrected the numbers throughout the entry using the current readings.
>
> **Corrections:**
> - Close: NDX 29272.46, NQ 29443.50 and QQQ 712.12, not 28961.08, 29100.25 and 704.45. The percentage changes were correct.
> - Session minimum: NDX 29017.13 at 10:02 ET (15:02 PL), not 28957.53 at 15:55 ET. The close is 130.09 pts below the maximum and 255.33 pts above the minimum (session range 385.42 pts).
> - Last hour of the session: NDX fell by 32.37 pts (-0.11%), not by 343.75 pts (-1.17%).
> - Cumulative flow (CVD) at the close: NDX −114.75 M [panic], NQ 21.79 K [accumulation], QQQ 2.85 M [market flare]. The direction was divergent, but it was the NDX flow that was negative, not the NQ flow.
> - Market breadth (TICKQ) at the close: -226.00 [market breakdown] with the SMA200 average at -26.25 [sell-off], not 437.00 and -17.45.
> - Average daily range (ADR) utilization: NDX 99.15%, NQ 99.20%, QQQ 99.38%, not 34.29%, 45.96% and 34.40%.
> - Drawdown from the highest close: -6.26%, not -7.26%.
> - The opening, the maximum, the MOC anomaly, the QQQ options and the basket data were correct. The session data health line measures the continuity of readings and does not detect such old readings.

**Session date:** 2026-10-26

> *Session close 2026-10-26: NDX 29272.46 (+1.09%), NQ 29443.50 (+1.12%), QQQ 712.12 (+1.11%).*

---

## Fundamentals #0022: Company filings: Marvell Technology, Workday; insider transactions

Date: 2026-10-26 10:10

Insiders on 23.10 sold shares for 8.8 million USD, including 4.8 million USD from 10b5-1 plans; market purchases were 0. The largest sale was reported by CrowdStrike (CRWD) insiders: 4.8 million USD.

Ramon Laguarta, Chairman and CEO of PepsiCo (PEP), sold 30,000 shares valued at 4.1 million USD.

## Fundamentals #0021: Western Digital: 1Q2027 results

Date: 2026-10-23 20:17
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-23-0021/


Western Digital (WDC) revenues increased in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 by 55.5% y/y to 4.38 billion USD, and earnings per share (GAAP) increased by 50.8% y/y to 4.63 USD.

### Quarterly results

Adjusted earnings per share was 4.64 USD, representing a 160.7% y/y increase compared to 1.78 USD a year earlier.

### Company guidance

In the second quarter of 2027, the company expects revenues in the range of 5.00 billion USD – 5.20 billion USD (an increase of 66.0% – 72.0%) and adjusted earnings per share at the level of 5.60–6.00 USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that the gross margin growth is permanent and is driven by pricing, higher recording density, and customers transitioning to higher capacity drives. According to management, the pricing environment is favorable, allowing for further increases in price per terabyte, including deliveries outside of long-term agreements. Management noted that customers highly rate the new HAMR drives due to their low failure rate, which provides confidence regarding the completion of their qualification process. According to management, the company does not intend to increase the number of drives produced, but is focusing on growth through higher recording density, and any potential slowdown among new AI cloud providers would not pose a serious problem due to sustained demand.

## Fundamentals #0019: Roper Technologies: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-22 18:41
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-22-0019/


Roper Technologies (ROP) revenues grew by 7.7% y/y in the third quarter to 2.17 billion USD, and earnings per share (reported) grew by 32.6% y/y to 4.88 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (reported, basic) was 4.90 USD (32.4% y/y) compared to 3.70 USD a year earlier.

### Company guidance

The company expects earnings per share (adjusted) in Q4 2026 to be at the level of 5.95–6.00 USD and in FY 2026 in the range of 22.35–22.40 USD.

### What management says

Management emphasized that credit revenues in Vertafore will resemble a subscription due to the model of purchasing a fixed pool in recurring contracts. According to management, the pace of Deltek customers' transition to the cloud is difficult to predict, but the company is pleased with the current momentum. Management indicated that the gross margin on AI agent tools is very good and close to software margins, with the priority remaining the speed of product implementation. According to management, AI products allow for rapid feedback collection and improving solutions after their introduction. Management noted that in Neptune, meter sales were close to expectations, but a higher share of cheaper mechanical models lowered revenues and margin. According to management, the project portfolio for static meters is strong, and projects have been shifted, which is intended to ensure better conditions next year.

## Fundamentals #0018: Honeywell International: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-22 18:39
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-22-0018/


Honeywell International (HON) revenues in Q3 were 4.99 billion USD (+1.3% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Operating margin was at 14.8% (6.4 pp y/y).

### Company guidance

The company expects revenues (FY 2026) in the range of 20.00 billion USD – 20.10 billion USD, while in Q4 2026 it forecasts organic revenue growth at a level of 5.0% – 6.0%.

### What management says

Management expressed high confidence regarding further improvement in sales and margin in the industrial automation segment due to the rapid improvement of this business's fundamentals. According to management, project activity in the area of process automation and technology remains very strong and diversified. Management emphasized that acquisitions represent an option for the company, and a key direction for development would be expanding the offering in the field of measurements and sensors. According to management, maintaining price increases requires ensuring good customer service and the continuous introduction of new products. Management indicated that the projected slowdown in organic growth at the end of the year results from caution, while short-cycle orders are very strong. Management also emphasized the implementation of artificial intelligence, stating that all teams have already been trained or are currently undergoing training.

## Fundamentals #0012: Intuitive Surgical: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-21 20:36
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-21-0012/


Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) revenue in Q3 was 3.05 billion USD (+21.7% y/y), while earnings per share (GAAP) fell to 1.49 USD (−23.6% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP, basic) stood at 1.50 USD (−24.2% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) increased to 3.00 USD (25.0% y/y). The company's operating income was 592.60 million USD (−22.0% y/y).

### What management says

According to management, a new reusable instruments program will be introduced in the USA at the end of Q1 next year, and in Europe in the second half of next year, which will bring the full effect by the end of next year. Management indicated that the impact of these changes on the gross margin will be minimal, as it will be offset by cost reductions next year.

URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-21-0010/


Vertex Pharmaceuticals (VRTX) filed a report of changes in management or board of directors.

Insiders sold shares for 26.1 million USD, including 26.1 million USD from 10b5-1 plans; market purchases amounted to 25 thousand USD. The largest sale was reported by Micron Technology (MU) insiders: 25.7 million USD.

The Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Chief Operating Officer of QUALCOMM (QCOM) sold 2,500 shares valued at 0.4 million USD under a 10b5-1 plan.

### Logbook: Accretion in the Shadow of the Great Correction

**1. Energy accretion in the Central Star**
the NDX Star shows a strong influx of energy from the Liquidity Nebula, reaching the level of 29536.02 (+1.17%) with CVD at the level of 140,5M, which classifies the state as euphoria. the NQ Probe is moving in accumulation mode (CVD: 28,52K) at a price of 29716.75 (+1.11%), while the Dyson Sphere (QQQ) registers a demand test (CVD: 350,06K) at the level of 718.28 (+1.19%). **2. Radiation and structure anomalies**

**Quantum Verdict:**
The discrepancy between energy flow euphoria (CVD) and negative broad market radiation (TICKQ) indicates concentrated mass accretion alongside structural weakness in the broad force fields.
